subject: general
question: Since 2017, the Finance Minister in India has been presenting the Union Budget for the country on which date?
solution:
The correct is __**1 February**__.

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Union Budget of India**, also referred to as the Annual Financial Statement* in Article 112 of the Constitution of India is the annual budget of the Republic of India.
 
• The union budget of India is presented by the **Finance Minister in the Parliament**.
 
• India's financial year starts from** 1 April**.
 
• Since 1947, there have been a total of **73 annual budgets, 14 interim budgets and four special budgets, or mini-budgets.**
 
• Currently the Finance Minister of India is **Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman**.
